basis: instance_budget_tokens, output_tokens, seconds_per_call, chars_per_token and the dossier estimate are planning estimates, not measurements: the flash decision maker prices every candidate with them (rules D4, D5 and port rule 7). system_text_chars and recorded are sizes the overseer measured with no model called: the system text of every composition of its knowledge pack, and its dossiers. No price and no latency is recorded, since no overseer agent has run on a model, and no model is named (decision D23).
name: epinoic-flash-router/cost-data-3

recorded.dossier_estimate: base_chars is the smallest dossier measured; chars_per_answer_char counts an answer's text as it reaches a dossier three times (its payload, its claims, the raw text a parse keeps); chars_per_translation one translation with its problem and its signed result

dossier_sizes.what: the canonical JSON of the dossiers the exporter issued for the recorded rounds

recorded.instance_budget: 200,000 tokens: the window of the deployment's cheapest tier as planned; the pack's deployer README measures which recorded dossiers fit windows of 128,000, 160,000 and 200,000 tokens
recorded.output_tokens_source: the pack's deployer README: an output budget of at least 8,000 tokens
